project_id.ui:description: ID of the Google Cloud project to deploy into. Required: a cloud connector doesn't choose a project.

region.ui:description: Region for the network and the VM. The e2-micro free tier applies in the three US regions.

zone.ui:description: Zone for the VM, in the region above. Leave empty to use the region's first available zone.

name_prefix.ui:description: A random suffix is added to keep names unique.

machine_type.ui:description: Machine type. e2-micro is in the Google Cloud free tier in the three US regions.

external_ip_enabled.ui:description: Give the VM an ephemeral external IP.

allowed_ssh_cidrs.ui:description: CIDR ranges allowed to reach the VM on port 22. Leave empty for no inbound traffic at all.

spot.ui:description: Much cheaper, but Google can stop the VM at any time. A stopped Spot VM keeps its disk.
